### Validate register user in registration popup form

Source: `UR_tests/07__setting_misc/popup.robot`

Steps as written:

```
SeleniumLibrary.Open Browser    ${url}    ${browser}    options=add_argument("--incognito")
Maximize Browser Window

Page Should Contain Element    //li[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-navigation-link user-registration-MyAccount-navigation-link--dashboard is-active']//a[contains(text(),'Dashboard')]
```
